CHAPTER 01

For My Baby,

♡ ───── ♡

Happy 29th monthsary, baby. ❤️

Two years and five months. Twenty-nine months of having you in my life. When I think about that number, I realize how many memories we have already created together.

We have had happy days, difficult days, misunderstandings, laughter, tears, and moments that I will always keep in my heart.

Ang dami na po nating pinagdaanan para makarating tayo sa point na ito. Baby,when I look back at everything that happened between us, I realize that our relationship was never really a perfect love story. We had happy moments, sad moments, misunderstandings, arguments, distance, and moments when we both felt tired.

And somehow, after everything, we found our way back to each other.

And through all of those moments Lab, you became someone very special to me.

Hindi ko sasabihing madali lahat. Hindi talaga. There were moments when I questioned things, moments when I cried, moments when I felt hurt, and moments when I wondered if we were really going to make it.

But despite all those moments, one thing remained: I still cared about you.

And maybe that's one of the reasons why we're here again, celebrating another month together.

This October, I just want us to have more happy days together. I hope we can enjoy every little moment, even if we're far from each other baby. I hope we can talk more, laugh more pa, and make more memories together.

We've been through a lot already, but I'm still thankful that we're here and still trying. I hope this month will be a fresh start for us. Less fights, less misunderstandings, and more love and understanding.

Thank you for being part of my story baby hihi.

CHAPTER 02

One Picture.

One little piece of our story.

A memory I want to keep forever. ❤️

This picture will always be one of the most memorable pictures for us, because this is where our story began. ❤️ We don't need hundreds of pictures to prove that our memories are specal. Even one picture can hold a whole story.

CHAPTER 03

Love stays

Distance is not always easy. Being far from you is one of the hardest parts of our relationship.

I wish we could see each other whenever we miss each other. I wish we could simply spend time together without worrying about the distance. I wish I could be there during your good days and your bad days, not just through messages or calls.

Sometimes, distance makes everything harder. But even when we are far apart, you are still someone I think about.

“Far from my eyes,
but never far from my heart.”

Maybe our story is not always perfect, but every month with you is still something I am thankful for.

CHAPTER 04

29 Months.

And still, it's you.

Happy 2 Years and 5 Months, Baby. ❤️

Here's to the memories we've already made and the memories still waiting for us.

29 MONTHS OF LOVE
